response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architecture and open-source contributions, but his title of 'Senior' and 10+ years of experience far exceed the junior/mid-level scope, and his German language limitation and high on-site requirement raise concerns about cultural and operational fit.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack ownership from API to UI with clean architecture focus
Strong open-source contributions and DevOps/CI/CD infrastructure skills
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role; risk of low retention or misalignment
Only basic German proficiency despite high on-site requirement in Berlin
Extensive background in DLang and embedded systems may divert focus from core stack
